from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test syntax validation and parsing."""

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P designator is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "1Y")

    def test_just_p(self):
        """P alone is invalid; at least one component required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_just_t(self):
        """PT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_t_without_time_component(self):
        """T must be followed by at least one time component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_invalid(self):
        """No whitespace anywhere in duration string."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1D T1H")

    def test_component_sign_invalid(self):
        """Sign on a component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P-1D")

    def test_lowercase_p_invalid(self):
        """P designator must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "p1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators_invalid(self):
        """All designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Year component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Month component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_week(self):
        """Week component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1W2W")

    def test_duplicate_day(self):
        """Day component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_hour(self):
        """Hour component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_minute_component_duplicate(self):
        """Minute component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_second(self):
        """Second component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1S2S")

    def test_wrong_order_month_before_year(self):
        """Components must be in order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1M1Y")

    def test_wrong_order_day_before_month(self):
        """Components must be in order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1D1M")

    def test_wrong_order_hour_before_day(self):
        """Components must be in order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1DT1H1D")

    def test_week_with_day(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P2W3D")

    def test_week_with_month(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1M2W")

    def test_week_with_year(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1Y2W")

    def test_week_with_time(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_fractional_year(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")

    def test_fractional_month(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1.5M")

    def test_fractional_non_last_component(self):
        """Only the last component may have a fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1.5D2H")

    def test_fraction_missing_digit_before_decimal(self):
        """At least one digit on each side of decimal separator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT.5S")

    def test_fraction_missing_digit_after_decimal(self):
        """At least one digit on each side of decimal separator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1.S")

    def test_multiple_decimal_points(self):
        """Only one decimal point allowed in fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1.5.5S")

    def test_multiple_comma_separators(self):
        """Only one comma separator allowed in fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1,5,5S")

    def test_mixed_decimal_separators(self):
        """Cannot mix . and , in same fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "PT1.5,5S")

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Empty string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "")

    def test_unknown_designator(self):
        """Unknown designators are invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1X")

    def test_m_before_t_is_months(self):
        """M before T is months, not minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_m_after_t_is_minutes(self):
        """M after T is minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1, 10), "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 1, 10, 30)


class TestSignHandling:
    """Test sign handling."""

    def test_positive_sign_explicit(self):
        """+ sign changes nothing."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "+P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 2)

    def test_negative_sign(self):
        """- sign makes the whole duration negative."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 10), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 9)

    def test_no_sign(self):
        """No sign is normal (positive)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 1), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 2)


class TestYearsComponent:
    """Test year component."""

    def test_single_year(self):
        """Add one year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_multiple_years(self):
        """Add multiple years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P5Y")
        assert result == datetime(2029, 1, 15)

    def test_year_with_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros are fine."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P001Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_negative_year(self):
        """Subtract years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "-P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 1, 15)

    def test_year_leap_day_to_non_leap(self):
        """Feb 29 -> Feb 28 when moving to non-leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_year_non_leap_to_leap(self):
        """Feb 28 -> Feb 28 when moving to leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2023, 2, 28), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 28)


class TestMonthsComponent:
    """Test month component."""

    def test_single_month(self):
        """Add one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 15)

    def test_multiple_months(self):
        """Add multiple months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P6M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 7, 15)

    def test_month_overflow_year(self):
        """Adding months can overflow to next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 11, 15), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_month_end_31st_to_28_day_month(self):
        """Jan 31 + P1M = Feb 28/29 (last day of month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_month_end_31st_to_30_day_month(self):
        """Jan 31 + P2M = Mar 31 (day exists)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 31)

    def test_month_end_31st_to_april(self):
        """Jan 31 + P3M = Apr 30 (last day of month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 4, 30)

    def test_month_end_non_leap_feb(self):
        """Dec 31 + P2M in non-leap year = Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2023, 12, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_negative_month(self):
        """Subtract one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_month_underflow_year(self):
        """Subtracting months can underflow to previous year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 15), "-P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 11, 15)

    def test_month_with_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros are fine."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P02M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 15)


class TestYearMonthTogether:
    """Test year and month applied together."""

    def test_year_and_month(self):

        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_years_months(self):

        assert result == datetime(2026, 4, 15)

    def test_year_month_overflow(self):
        """Year/month can overflow year boundary."""

        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_year_month(self):
        """Negative year and month."""

        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 15)

    def test_year_month_sequence_matters_negative(self):

        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

        """Add one second."""

class TestBoundaryConditions:
    """Test boundary conditions and edge cases."""

    def test_max_datetime_overflow(self):
        """Adding beyond max datetime raises ValueError."""
        max_dt = datetime(9999, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(max_dt, "P1D")

    def test_min_datetime_underflow(self):
        """Subtracting below min datetime raises ValueError."""
        min_dt = datetime(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(min_dt, "-P1D")

    def test_leap_year_2024(self):
        """2024 is a leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_2000(self):
        """2000 is a leap year (divisible by 400)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2000, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2000, 2, 29)

    def test_non_leap_year_1900(self):
        """1900 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not 400)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(1900, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(1900, 3, 1)

    def test_december_31_to_january(self):
        """Adding days from Dec 31 to next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 12, 31), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_full_duration_string(self):
        """Add all types of components at once."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        # Year: 2026-01-01
        # Months (2): 2026-03-01
        # Days (3): 2026-03-04
        # Hours (4): 2026-03-04 04:00:00
        # Minutes (5): 2026-03-04 04:05:00
        # Seconds (6): 2026-03-04 04:05:06
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6)

    def test_months_and_days_applied_sequentially_but_correctly(self):
        """Months applied first, then days (not mixed)."""
        # Apply 1 month then 1 day, not 1 month-day
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        # 2024-01-31 + 1M = 2024-02-29 (overflow to last day)
        # 2024-02-29 + 1D = 2024-03-01
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_days_and_hours_applied_in_order(self):
        """Days applied before hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 0, 0), "P1DT1H")
        # 2025-01-01 23:00:00 + 1D = 2025-01-02 23:00:00
        # 2025-01-02 23:00:00 + 1H = 2025-01-03 00:00:00
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_leap_year_february_handling(self):
        """Leap year with month addition."""
        # 2024 is leap year; 2024-01-31 + 1M = 2024-02-29
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_to_non_leap_year(self):
        """Adding year from leap year Feb 29."""
        # 2024-02-29 (leap year) + 1Y = 2025-02-28 (non-leap year)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_negative_then_positive_equivalent(self):
        """Negative and positive durations are inverses."""
        start = datetime(2025, 6, 15)
        after_add = add_duration(start, "P2M")
        after_subtract = add_duration(after_add, "-P2M")
        assert after_subtract == start

    def test_multiple_months_overflow(self):
        """Adding multiple months with day overflow."""
        # 2024-01-31 + 3M = Jan->Feb(29)->Mar(31)->Apr(30) = 2024-04-30
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 4, 30)

    def test_fractional_and_integer_parts(self):
        """Fractional component combines with integer parts."""
        # PT1H30M30.5S = 1 hour, 30 minutes, 30.5 seconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1H30M30.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30, 30, 500000)

class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and boundary conditions."""

    def test_zero_duration(self):
        """P0D (and variations) has no effect."""
        start = datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30, 45)
        result = add_duration(start, "P0D")
        assert result == start

    def test_very_large_duration(self):
        """Very large duration values."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P9999D")
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1) + __import__("datetime").timedelta(days=9999)
        assert result == expected

    def test_datetime_with_microseconds(self):
        """Input datetime with microseconds is preserved/modified correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_on_last_component_only(self):
        """Only the last component in string can be fractional."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT2H3.5M")
        # 1D + 2H + 3.5M (3 minutes 30 seconds)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 2, 3, 30)

    def test_minimum_datetime(self):
        """Add to minimum datetime."""
        from datetime import datetime as dt, timedelta
        min_dt = dt.min
        result = add_duration(min_dt, "P1D")
        expected = min_dt + timedelta(days=1)
        assert result == expected

    def test_datetime_at_year_end(self):
        """Operations at year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_zero_fractional_digit(self):
        """Fractional component with many zeros: PT1.00000S."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.00000S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_non_leap_year_february(self):
        """February in non-leap year has 28 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_year_wrap(self):
        """Duration that wraps multiple years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 11, 15), "P27M")
        # 27 months = 2 years + 3 months
        assert result == datetime(2027, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_wraps_to_previous_year(self):
        """Negative duration wraps to previous year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 15)

    def test_very_small_fractional_second(self):
        """Very small fractional second (high precision)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        # 0.000001 seconds = 1 microsecond
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_fractional_minute_precision(self):
        """Fractional minute with high precision."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0166666667M")
        # ~0.0167 minutes = ~1 second (60 * 0.0167 ≈ 1)
        # Rounding to nearest microsecond
        assert 0 < result.microsecond < 2000000  # Should be close to 1 second

    def test_range_error_overflow_max_datetime(self):
        """Adding beyond maximum datetime raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            # Try to overflow datetime.max
            max_dt = datetime.max
            add_duration(max_dt, "P1D")

    def test_range_error_underflow_min_datetime(self):

class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test parsing and validation of ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1Y")

    def test_empty_duration(self):
        """P alone is invalid without components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_p_without_time_component(self):
        """PT without components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_p_with_incomplete_date(self):
        """P with T but no time component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_valid_plus_sign(self):
        """+ sign is valid and changes nothing."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+P1D") == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_valid_minus_sign(self):
        """- sign makes duration negative."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2), "-P1D") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_sign_on_component(self):
        """Sign on a component (e.g., P-1D) is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")

    def test_component_order_violation_md_swapped(self):
        """Components must appear in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1Y")

    def test_component_order_violation_dw_swapped(self):
        """D must come before W."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1W")

    def test_component_order_violation_time_before_date(self):
        """T must come after date components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1D")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Year can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Month can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_day(self):
        """Day can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_week(self):
        """Week can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1W2W")

    def test_weeks_with_days(self):
        """W cannot be combined with D."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W3D")

    def test_weeks_with_hours(self):
        """W cannot be combined with time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_whitespace_in_duration(self):
        """No whitespace allowed anywhere."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P 1D")

    def test_lowercase_p(self):
        """P must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1D")

    def test_lowercase_designator(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_m_before_t_is_months(self):
        """M before T represents months."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1M") == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_m_after_t_is_minutes(self):
        """M after T represents minutes."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0), "PT1M") == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 1)

    def test_duplicate_hour(self):
        """Hour can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_duplicate_minute(self):
        """Minute can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1M2M")
